title: 番外II 紫虚异域日记Ⅳ
content_zh:
之后几天紫虚一直是一脸懵圈的飞，当然这种飞行紫虚也不敢飞的太快，靠着仙人的直觉，他选了一个方向在飞。
不过飞来飞去到处都只是海水，也亏紫虚是仙人之躯根本不需要进食，这要是正常的内气离体，可能会被饿死。
虽说仙人可以不吃不喝，但是一直这么低空飞行，飞的时间长了，紫虚也想吐，说起来要不是时不时从海里面冒出来一些大鱼，估计紫虚已经彻底懵圈了。
毕竟在海上没了方向，紫虚完全找不到飞回去的方式，顺带仙人最强的星辰定位技术，对于南半球的星空也是没有半点办法的。
静静的虚立在海面上，紫虚开始思考，一直飞在海上也不是事。
紫虚虚立在海面上，完全没有注意到海水之下一头虎鲸暗暗地窥视着海面上的他。
和人类内气离体不同，动物拥有内气更多的是依靠于本能，所以他们天生在感知上要远远强于人类，所以在虎鲸看来海面上那个紫色的家伙吃了大补。
默默地潜伏之下，虎鲸骤然从海水中跃出，嘴张到最大，一排排锋利的牙齿，在阳光之下反射着残忍的光泽，朝着紫虚凶狠的咬去。
“嘭！”紫虚条件反射一般的一挥拂尘，甩在虎鲸的脑袋上，直接将比他巨大了数十倍的虎鲸打回了海水之中。
就跟钓鱼一样，紫虚最近几次因为靠近海面，被海中的大鱼当作零食都攻击了好几次了，到现在紫虚甚至都有些习惯于这种攻击了，没办法，这恶心的蓝色海水，让紫虚不找点乐子他实在不知道该做什么了。
虽说把自身当做鱼饵钓鱼这种事情确实有些丧心病狂，不过紫虚还是相当有自信的，怎么说都是相当于内气离体极致的高手，对于自身战斗力还是有点自信的。
“上天有好生之德，这次就放过你了。”蹂躏了一番虎鲸，看着已经翻了肚皮装死的虎鲸，紫虚心情舒畅了很多，【真希望这就是贾文和啊，】紫虚默默地想到。
心情舒爽了之后，紫虚估摸了一下大致方向，又开始飞行，不过闭着眼睛在草坪上走路的人都知道，没有参照物，人类走的方向最后构成的永远是一个圈，最多只是每个人的圈大小不同。
而紫虚现在就是这么一个情况，飞行高度很低，飞的也不是很快，他完全不知道自己飞的其实不是直线，而完全相似的海水，紫虚也没有办法找出一个参照物。
因而紫虚这几天实际上一直在一个半径几百里的圈里面飞，当然紫虚自己是不知道这个事实的。
“这到底怎么飞才是一个头啊。”紫虚估摸着自己又飞了两个时辰，一脸唏嘘的虚立在海面上开始思考。
至于太阳，最近是从那边升起的，紫虚已经彻底不想思考了，毕竟按照东升西落的常规经验来猜测的话，正午的太阳应该在他的南边，然而紫虚最头疼的一点在于，如果太阳是东升西落，那么太阳现在在自己的北边……
太阳怎么能在北边，这必须不能，在紫虚多年的记忆之中，太阳一直都在自己的南边，这和太阳东升西落是一个既定事实。
然而现在的事实，告诉紫虚，要么太阳不是东升西落，要么太阳不是朝南，再要么太阳疯了。
不朝南的话，坐北朝南，阳面什么的不都成了颠覆，绝对不行！

因而紫虚现在直接不相信太阳东升西落，也不相信正午的太阳身处南边，他现在只靠直觉判断方向，紫虚就是这么的智慧！
然而时至现在，紫虚也没弄出来一个东西南北，不过好在仙人不需要吃喝，倒也不存在耗不起，东西南北吗，迟早就能弄清楚。
抱着这样的想法，紫虚觉得自己又需要消遣一下，飞的有些吐了，不过这次不等紫虚落下去，一头大约有五十米的巨大虎鲨张大着嘴巴要将紫虚一口吞了。
海水的腥气，还有那能一口将紫虚吞下去的凶残巨口，紫虚不由得一怔，下一瞬间反应过来，当即朝着身后倒飞而去，不过随即紫虚突然发现那张巨口居然还朝着自己延伸而来。
“给我破！”紫虚手上的拂尘猛地一甩，无数细丝带着超高的震动朝着正面的虎鲨削去。
结果不等紫虚将虎鲨重创，只见对方狠狠的咬下，将紫虚拂尘的细丝直接咬断，当然虎鲨不少的牙齿也被拂尘斩断。
受了一击之后，虎鲨落到海水中，一道数十米的海浪朝着紫虚砸来，差点将紫虚整个人按到海里，不过紫虚也不是好欺负的，骤然爆发力量从海浪之中冲了出来，但是免不了被海水浇了一个落汤鸡。
“还真成精了？”紫虚大怒，手上的拂尘一抖，变成了一柄紫色的长剑，凭着感觉朝着海水下的虎鲨斩去，下一瞬海水直接分开，而虎鲨也被砍掉了一大块肉。
不过随后虎鲨便在紫虚吃惊的眼神之中吞下了自己的那块被砍下了的肉，然后朝着海面上的紫虚爆发出一声大吼。
虎鲨正面的海水就像是受到了操控一般凶猛的朝着紫虚砸去，数百吨受到压缩的海水，爆发出极高的速度，在紫虚来不及躲闪之前直接命中了紫虚，差点将紫虚身形打散！
紫虚冲出来的时候身形甚至略显出一些透明，不过随后就恢复了大半，双眼丝毫不掩饰自己的冷厉，手上的紫色长剑一挥之下直接分出十几道，在紫虚的操控下朝着水下的虎鲨发动了攻击。
不过那虎鲨也是狡猾，在发现紫虚不好惹之后，直接朝着深海钻去，这下紫虚实力就算再强也拿近千米海面下的虎鲨没什么办法。
“该死的南华，那个混蛋非要引爆神石，看看这海面下都是些什么玩意！”紫虚有些抓狂的说道，这要是在空中或者陆上，就这么一个内气离体初入的家伙，紫虚分分钟将之做成生鱼片。
可惜这是在海里，就算紫虚这种仙人有避水诀这种秘术，但是潜入数百米也最多是想想，至于千多米乃至更深，那就只有典韦那种人类身躯的极限才能承受的压力了。
“咦……”就在紫虚骂人的时候，天边一道紫光和红光朝着他飞来，随后一道紫光没入他的身躯之中，红光就朝着天边飞去，当即紫虚再无丝毫的犹豫爆发出所有的速度追去。
不得不承认紫虚的速度非常夸张，但是红光的速度更夸张，几乎是转瞬间红光就消失了在天边，不过紫虚却没有丝毫的迟疑，继续爆发着自己的速度，直到飞到了一处大陆，一块到处都是冰的大陆。
【唉，看来是追丢了，不过还好居然遇到了一块大陆，休整一下，顺带找人确定一下地方和方向。】紫虚心道，不过这时一股寒风扫过，就连紫虚这种内气离体也有些冷。
时间一点点的流逝，紫虚没找到人，当然这不重要，重要的是，太阳该落山了，但是直到现在太阳还是不落山。
【也许这里的太阳落山晚。】紫虚安慰着自己，然而直到一个月后太阳依旧没有落山……
content_en:
For the next few days, Zixu kept flying in confusion. Of course, Zixu did not dare to fly too fast in this kind of flying. Relying on the intuition of the immortal, he chose a direction to fly.
However, there is only sea water flying around everywhere, and thanks to Zixu's immortal body, there is no need to eat at all. If the normal inner energy leaves the body, he may starve to death.
Although immortals can live without eating or drinking, they have been flying at such a low altitude for a long time, and Zixu also feels like vomiting. Speaking of which, if some big fish hadn't emerged from the sea from time to time, Zixu would have been completely confused.
After all, Zixu had no direction at sea and couldn't find a way to fly back. By the way, the immortal's strongest star positioning technology had no way to deal with the starry sky in the southern hemisphere.
Standing quietly on the sea, Zixu began to think that it would not be a problem to keep flying on the sea.
Zi Xuxu stood on the sea, completely unaware of a killer whale secretly peeping at him under the sea.
Unlike human beings whose inner energy is separated from the body, animals' inner energy relies more on instinct, so their perception is much stronger than that of humans. Therefore, in the eyes of killer whales, the purple guy on the sea has taken a huge tonic.
Silently lurking, the killer whale suddenly jumped out of the sea, opened its mouth to its maximum, and rows of sharp teeth reflected a cruel luster in the sun, biting fiercely at Zixu.
"Bang!" Zixu swung his fly whisk like a conditioned reflex and threw it on the killer whale's head, directly knocking the killer whale dozens of times bigger than him back into the sea.
Just like fishing, Zixu has been attacked by big fish as snacks in the sea several times recently because he was close to the sea. Now Zixu is even somewhat accustomed to such attacks. There is nothing he can do about it. This disgusting blue water makes Zixu really don't know what to do if he doesn't have some fun.
Although it is indeed a bit crazy to use oneself as bait for fishing, Zixu is still quite confident. After all, he is equivalent to a master who can separate his inner energy from the body, and he is still somewhat confident in his own combat power.
"God is kind enough to let you live this time." After ravaging the killer whale and looking at the killer whale that had turned over and pretended to be dead, Zixu felt much better. "I really hope this is Jia Wenhe," Zixu thought silently.
After feeling comfortable, Zixu estimated the general direction and started flying again. However, anyone walking on the lawn with their eyes closed knows that without reference, the direction humans walk will always form a circle. At most, the size of each circle is different.
And Zixu is in such a situation now. He is flying at a very low altitude and not flying very fast. He has no idea that what he is flying is not actually a straight line, and Zixu has no way to find a reference for the completely similar sea water.
Therefore, Zixu has actually been flying in a circle with a radius of several hundred miles in the past few days. Of course, Zixu himself does not know this fact.
"How on earth can this flying end?" Zixu estimated that he had been flying for another two hours, and he stood on the sea with a sigh on his face and began to think.
As for where the sun rises recently, Zixu no longer wants to think about it. After all, according to the conventional experience of rising in the east and setting in the west, the sun at noon should be to his south. However, the most troublesome thing for Zixu is that if the sun rises in the east and sets in the west, then the sun is now north of him...
How can the sun be in the north? It must not be. In Zixu's many years of memory, the sun has always been in the south of him. This is an established fact that the sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
However, the current facts tell Zixu that either the sun does not rise in the east and set in the west, or the sun is not facing south, or the sun is crazy.
If it doesn’t face south, if you sit north and face south, the sunny side will be subversive, absolutely not!
Therefore, Zixu now directly does not believe that the sun rises in the east and sets in the west, nor does he believe that the sun is at noonTo the south, he now only relies on intuition to judge the direction. Zixu is so smart!
However, until now, Zixu has not found out the east, west, south, north, and south. Fortunately, the immortals do not need to eat and drink, and there is no way they can't afford it. Will they be able to figure out the east, west, south, north, or south sooner or later?
With this idea in mind, Zixu felt that he needed some entertainment again, so he vomited a little. But this time, before Zixu could fall, a huge tiger shark about fifty meters long opened its mouth wide and tried to swallow Zixu in one gulp.
The fishy smell of the sea water, and the ferocious giant mouth that could swallow Zixu in one bite, Zixu couldn't help but be startled. The next moment he reacted, he immediately flew backwards behind him, but then Zixu suddenly found that the giant mouth was still extending towards him.
"Break it!" Zixu flicked the fly whisk in his hand, and countless filaments were sliced ​​towards the tiger shark in front of him with extremely high vibration.
As a result, before Zixu could seriously injure Tiger Shark, he saw the opponent bite down hard and directly cut off the filaments of Zixu's whisk. Of course, many of Tiger Shark's teeth were also cut off by the whisk.
After receiving a blow, the tiger shark fell into the sea, and a wave of tens of meters hit Zixu, almost pushing Zixu into the sea. However, Zixu was not easy to bully, and suddenly burst out of strength and rushed out of the waves, but he was inevitably drowned by the sea water.
"Have you really become a spirit?" Zixu was furious. The fly whisk in his hand turned into a long purple sword, and he slashed towards the tiger shark under the sea water based on his feeling. The sea water parted directly in the next moment, and a large piece of meat was cut off from the tiger shark.
But then the tiger shark swallowed the chopped piece of meat in Zixu's surprised eyes, and then roared towards Zixu on the sea.
The seawater in front of the tiger shark slammed towards Zixu ferociously as if it was controlled. Hundreds of tons of compressed seawater burst out at extremely high speeds, hitting Zixu directly before Zixu had time to dodge, and almost shattered Zixu's figure!
When Zixu rushed out, his figure was even slightly transparent, but then he recovered most of his energy. His eyes did not hide his coldness at all. The purple sword in his hand split into more than a dozen branches with one swing, and under the control of Zixu, he launched an attack on the underwater tiger shark.
However, the tiger shark was also cunning. After discovering that Zixu was not easy to mess with, he headed directly towards the deep sea. Now, no matter how strong Zixu was, there was nothing he could do against the tiger shark nearly a thousand meters under the sea.
"Damn Nan Hua, that bastard insists on detonating the divine stone, look what's under the sea!" Zixu said a little crazy, if this was in the air or on land, for such a guy whose inner energy has left the body for the first time, Zixu would make it into sashimi in minutes.
It's a pity that this is in the sea. Even if an immortal like Zixu has the secret technique of avoiding water, diving hundreds of meters is just a matter of thinking. As for more than a thousand meters or even deeper, only the limit of a human body like Dian Wei can withstand the pressure.
"Eh..." Just when Zixu was cursing, a purple light and a red light flew towards him from the sky, and then a purple light disappeared into his body, and the red light flew towards the sky. Zixu immediately burst out with all his speed to chase without any hesitation.
I have to admit that Zixu's speed is very exaggerated, but the speed of the red light is even more exaggerated. The red light disappeared from the horizon almost instantly. However, Zixu did not hesitate at all and continued to explode at his speed until he flew to a continent, a continent full of ice.
[Alas, it seems that I lost the pursuit, but fortunately I encountered a continent. I took a rest and found someone to confirm the location and direction. 】Zixu thought to himself, but at this time a cold wind swept through, and even Zixu's internal energy was a little cold outside the body.
Time passed little by little, and Zixu didn't find anyone. Of course, this was not important. What was important was that the sun was about to set, but it still didn't set until now.[Maybe the sun sets late here. 】Zixu comforted himself, but the sun still did not set until a month later...
